+# S007 critical exteriors and heavy-endblock excess
+
+These are necessary constraints on an actual finite simple12-critical biplanar graph, not an11-colouring theorem. Gallai low-block structure and the extension criterion retain the external dependency SRC-0027; K9 exclusion is SRC-0014. Novelty is not established. The source's Section2.3 already uses spare colours and independent exterior vertices; this application does not claim that method as new.
+
+## A spare colour exposes each low component
+
+Let L be the degree11 vertices, H its complement, and C any component of G[L]. Then
+
+    chi(G-C)=11.
+
+Proof. Criticality supplies the upper bound11. Suppose instead that F=G-C has a proper colouring with colours1..10. Colour11 is unused. Restrict to its vertices in H. SRC-0027 Theorem1.3 applies since every vertex outside H has degree11; components of L have no edges between them. If that restriction already satisfies criterion(a) or(b) for C, extend through C and retain the colouring of the other components from F, contradiction. Otherwise every exterior set is rainbow and noncut vertices in an endblock have the same exterior palette.
+
+If C has a light pair x,y, their actual exterior sets X,Y differ and have equal sizes. Choose a vertex a in X\Y and recolour just a with the unused colour11. This is proper in all of F. The new palettes differ, so criterion(b) extends C.
+
+If C is not light and has at least two vertices, choose an endblock B. All its noncut vertices have identical actual exterior set A. If B=K_s, s<=8, then |A|=12-s. If A were a clique, one noncut vertex together with A and the other noncut core vertices gives a clique of order12 when B=C, or11 when B has one cut vertex. Either contradicts K9 exclusion. Thus A has independent vertices a,b. Recolour both with colour11; they are nonadjacent and the colour was unused, so properness is preserved and criterion(a) holds. If B is an odd-cycle block (nontriangle), every noncut vertex has internal degree2 and |A|=9. A cannot be a clique by K9 exclusion, so the same recolouring applies. Triangles are included in the clique case. For C a singleton, its11 exterior neighbours cannot be a clique, and the same independent-pair recolouring applies. Extension again contradicts criticality.
+
+This proof handles empty H by the supposition and disconnected F without any common planar embedding. It changes F only on H, so its existing colours on L-C remain proper and extend unchanged. Therefore chi(F)=11. In particular, when L is nonempty and connected, chi(G[H])=11. With several low components, deleting one component is not deleting all of L: no claim that chi(H)=11 in general follows. Nor can these separate recolourings automatically be performed simultaneously; chosen vertices for different components may be adjacent.
+
+## Heavy clique endblock support bound
+
+Let an endblock B=K_s, s<=8, of a nonsingle-block low component have noncut core T of order r=s-1, cut vertex z and identical actual exterior set A of order12-s. Every vertex of T has exactly the same outside neighbourhood A union{z}. For every independent Z subset A with |Z|=q>=2,
+
+    sum_(a in Z)(deg_G(a)-12) >= (s-2)q-11.
+
+Proof. Criticality gives a proper11-colouring phi of G-T. If two vertices of Z could be recoloured with the same colour i without affecting the rest, the colours appearing on A would repeat. The entire outside boundary of T would then use at most(|A|-1)+1=12-s=11-r colours, leaving at least r colours to assign injectively to T. That is a proper11-colouring of G, contradiction.
+
+Consequently, for each of the11 colours, at most one vertex of Z has no neighbour of that colour in G-(T union Z). Z is independent, so these are exactly the constraints needed for the proposed simultaneous recolouring of two vertices. At least q-1 vertices of Z are blocked for each colour. Each edge from Z to G-(T union Z) contributes at most one such colour/vertex incidence, giving at least11(q-1) edges across that cut. Every a in Z also has r neighbours in T and none in Z. Summing its total degrees and subtracting12q gives
+
+    rq+11(q-1)-12q=(r-1)q-11=(s-2)q-11.
+
+All a belong to H by definition of exterior; the summands are nonnegative. No upper-degree premise or greedy extension of uncoloured exterior vertices is assumed. We start with an actual colouring of all G-T, keep all vertices outside the selected pair fixed, and use only the independence of Z. This is a counting constraint from criticality, not a positive graph construction.
+
+For a heavy K8 endblock, its seven noncut vertices form K7. An edge within A would complete K9 with that core, so A is independent of order4. The inequality yields
+
+    sum_(a in A)(deg_G(a)-12) >=13,
+
+and at least one of these four exterior vertices has degree>=16. The local subgraph on T, A and z contains K7 joined to five independent vertices after deleting any edges from z to A. Its actual biplanarity challenge is recorded separately, not inferred from Euler or its8-colouring. A single-block K8 component is light as in S006; this heavy conclusion applies only to a genuine endblock with a cut vertex.
+
+For a heavy single-block K_s component, the same counting proof with r=s and no cut yields sum_Z(deg-12)>=(s-1)q-11. A single-block K8 is already impossible as heavy by K9 exclusion. Different endblocks may reuse A and its edges, so summing these bounds over endblocks without controlling overlaps would double count. These conditions do not contradict unbounded Q, h or D.
+
+## Rejected paths and remaining theorem obligations
+
+Recolouring independent neighbours with an unused colour is legitimate only when the exterior colouring uses at most10 colours. An arbitrary11-colouring has no guaranteed spare colour. The triangle fan K1 joined to P4 has two nonadjacent path endpoints that are forced to have different colours in every proper3-colouring; this is a planar generic counterexample to dropping the spare-colour hypothesis. The programme does not extrapolate it to a12-critical witness.
+
+The all-order result chi(G-C)=11 establishes precisely where the spare colour is absent in a critical obstruction. It does not bound chi(H) for multiple components, furnish a simultaneous independent selection, certify contractions/identifications in both layers, or prove any reducible configuration. K9-free heavy boundaries are not automatically flexible in an11-chromatic exterior. The high-excess support bound permits concentrated excess and repeated boundaries. Large-deficit control, all-component extension, a universal proof and independent adversarial review remain open. The S005/S006 Gallai inequalities both remain valid with their different component corrections.

+# S007 necessary encodings and independent global challenge
+
+The target is exact thickness-two chromatic number. No SAT relaxation is a planar witness. The completion premise is the classical planar augmentation fact, also inspected in SRC-0009(X2). The existing Cover necessity/lex proof (CLM-0028) remains the starting point; arbitrary deficits permit shared pairs and edges outside the input.
+
+## StrongCover necessity at any deficit
+
+For any genuine biplanar n>=4 input, independently complete its two planar layers to sphere triangulations on the same vertex set. For every vertex set S, a completed layer induced on S is simple planar and has at most3|S|-6 edges when |S|>=3. StrongCover uses every union of closed-twin bags and every one-vertex complement as selected necessary instances of this inequality. It also forbids monochromatic input K5s, because each layer is planar. Neither set of cuts claims a complete planarity characterization. Vertex sets of sizes0..2 are deliberately omitted from the Euler3s-6 formula. Auxiliary cardinality variables admit every primary solution obeying those inequalities.
+
+The existing common-order layer-swap/input automorphism lex constraints are sound by selecting the lexicographically least primary edge vector among all completed solutions in its symmetry orbit. Listed permutations are checked as input automorphisms. The extra cuts are true in every actual planar completion, whether or not the chosen bag partition is invariant under a permutation. No isolated first-edge unit from Cegar is inserted into Cover. Connectivity/link cut syntax and necessity remain as in the original Cover. A lack of a satisfying relaxed model requires an actually checked DRAT proof before any exclusion; a satisfying model still needs both actual layers/rotations and all colouring obligations.
+
+## Distinct global faces for D<=2
+
+For input edges E and completed layers T1,T2, let o(e) in{0,1,2} be occurrence multiplicity. Input pairs have o>=1. The exact surplus identity is
+
+    D=6n-12-|E|=sum_(e in E)(o(e)-1)+sum_(e notin E)o(e).
+
+If the same labelled triangle is facial in both layers, each of its three pairs has o=2. Each input pair costs one surplus, and each noninput pair costs two. Thus D>=3. Therefore when D<=2, the two sets of facial triples are disjoint. This proves the new extension beyond the inherited D<=1 shortcut; it NEVER permits a distinct-global-face premise at D>=3. D3 can have three doubled input pairs forming a common face; no contrary assertion is made.
+
+For D=2, combine the two actual facial sets into a single0/1 selection. Every pair has exactly2o(e) incident selected faces. Input pairs have one surplus bit, noninput pairs two monotone multiplicity bits; total surplus is2. A selected triangle has at most two noninput pairs, since three already cost>=3. This yields the separate no-lex global incidence CNF. The converse is absent: layer consistency, connectivity and vertex links are deliberately forgotten. Its SAT assignments cannot decide biplanarity. It shares the classical completion premise, PySAT library and native solver with other encodings; its independent numbering/no symmetry and direct projected-incidence counts are separate checks, not external formal verification.
+
+## Controls, scope and trust
+
+Before new verdicts, all40 retained full S005/S006 refutations and K9/row165 were cold regenerated and freshly native-checked. All271 chromatic archive/CNF hashes and explicit10-colourings were audited; exactly the four D2 targets' lower proofs were freshly checked. The23 positive examples were run through the stronger model and independently checked as exact disjoint splits with two sphere rotations. A further23 actual completions were pinned against StrongCover, checking every primary constraint admits suitable auxiliaries.
+
+Those23 examples do not by themselves exercise the D<=2 premise. Three exact D2 deletion controls on the known42-vertex disjoint-triangulation witness independently checked actual rotations/triangular faces and every global face/multiplicity bit against the new CNF. These exercise two new noninput pairs; they do not establish test coverage of every possible D2 overlap type. The all-order surplus proof, not the controls, establishes necessity for every type.
+
+The four global D2 models were independently cold regenerated. Every native SAT assignment satisfied every generated clause, then a direct count checked pair multiplicities, coverage, total surplus2 and selected-face count4n-8. Their projections and native logs are retained. All four are SAT_RELAXATION, leaving biplanarity UNKNOWN. They show that surplus/distinct global incidence by itself fails on these four targets.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""CAM-0008 necessary planar-subset/K5 cuts for arbitrary-deficit Cover."""
+import itertools
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from pysat.card import CardEnc, EncType
+from triangulation_cover import Cover
+from biplanar_cnf import read_edges
+
+VERSION = 'S007-subsets-K5-Dle2-v1'
+
+
+class StrongCover(Cover):
+    def __init__(self, edges, lex=False, short_links=False):
+        super().__init__(edges, lex, short_links)
+        adj = {v: {v} for v in range(self.n)}
+        for a, b in edges:
+            adj[a].add(b); adj[b].add(a)
+        groups = {}
+        for v in range(self.n):
+            groups.setdefault(tuple(sorted(adj[v])), []).append(v)
+        self.groups = list(groups.values())
+        # The campaign restricts expensive complete bag-union generation to <=11 bags.
+        assert len(self.groups) <= 11
+        subsets = {tuple(v for j, bag in enumerate(self.groups) if mask >> j & 1 for v in bag)
+                   for mask in range(1, 1 << len(self.groups))}
+        subsets |= {tuple(v for v in range(self.n) if v != omitted) for omitted in range(self.n)}
+        subsets = sorted({tuple(sorted(s)) for s in subsets if 3 <= len(s) < self.n})
+        initial = len(self.base)
+        for s in subsets:
+            bound = 3 * len(s) - 6
+            if len(s) * (len(s)-1)//2 <= bound:
+                continue
+            for layer in range(2):
+                self.base.extend(CardEnc.atmost([self.E(layer, a, b) for a, b in itertools.combinations(s, 2)],
+                    bound=bound, vpool=self.pool, encoding=EncType.seqcounter).clauses)
+        original = set(edges)
+        k5 = 0
+        for vs in itertools.combinations(range(self.n), 5):
+            es = list(itertools.combinations(vs, 2))
+            if all(e in original for e in es):
+                k5 += 1
+                for layer in range(2):
+                    self.base.append([-self.E(layer, *e) for e in es])
+        deficit = 6*self.n - 12 - len(edges)
+        if deficit <= 2:
+            self.base.extend([[-self.F(0, *q), -self.F(1, *q)] for q in self.triples])
+        self.static = dict(version=VERSION, groups=self.groups, subset_count=len(subsets),
+            input_K5_count=k5, distinct_faces_enabled=deficit <= 2,
+            extra_clauses=len(self.base)-initial)
+
+    def save(self, prefix, verdict, iterations, start):
+        meta = super().save(prefix, verdict, iterations, start)
+        meta['static'] = self.static
+        Path(prefix+'.result.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta, indent=1)+'\n', newline='\n')
+        Path(prefix+'.cuts.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(lex=self.lex,
+            short_links=self.short_links, cuts=self.cuts, static=self.static), indent=1)+'\n', newline='\n')
+        return meta
+
+
+def main():
+    if sys.argv[1] == 'check':
+        _, _, ef, prefix = sys.argv
+        d = json.loads(Path(prefix+'.cuts.json').read_text())
+        c = StrongCover(read_edges(ef), d['lex'], d.get('short_links', False))
+        assert c.static == d['static']
+        c.cuts = d['cuts']
+        c.write_cnf(Path(prefix+'.regenerated.cnf'))
+        assert Path(prefix+'.cnf').read_bytes() == Path(prefix+'.regenerated.cnf').read_bytes()
+        print('PASS stronger necessary CNF cold regeneration', len(c.cuts), 'lazy cuts')
+    else:
+        _, ef, prefix, seconds, *flags = sys.argv
+        print(json.dumps(StrongCover(read_edges(ef), '--lex' in flags).run(prefix, float(seconds))))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+def encode(edges):
+    n=1+max(max(e) for e in edges);eset=set(edges)
+    assert n>=4 and len(eset)==len(edges)==6*n-14
+    pairs=list(itertools.combinations(range(n),2));pool=IDPool()
+    bits={e:[pool.id(('extra',e))] if e in eset else [pool.id(('present',e)),pool.id(('double',e))] for e in pairs}
+    triples=[q for q in itertools.combinations(range(n),3)
+        if sum(e not in eset for e in itertools.combinations(q,2))<=2]
+    f={q:pool.id(('global-face',q)) for q in triples}
+    cls=CardEnc.equals([x for values in bits.values() for x in values],bound=2,vpool=pool,encoding=EncType.totalizer).clauses
+    incident={e:[] for e in pairs}
+    for q in triples:
+        for e in itertools.combinations(q,2):
+            incident[e].append(f[q])
+            if e not in eset:cls.append([-f[q],bits[e][0]])
+    def eq(lits,demand,gates):
+        if len(lits)<demand:
+            cls.append(gates)
+        else:
+            cls.extend(gates+c for c in CardEnc.equals(lits,bound=demand,vpool=pool,encoding=EncType.seqcounter).clauses)
+    for e in pairs:
+        fs=incident[e]
+        if e in eset:
+            z=bits[e][0];eq(fs,2,[z]);eq(fs,4,[-z])
+        else:
+            p,d=bits[e];cls.append([-d,p])
+            cls.extend([[p,-v] for v in fs])
+            eq(fs,2,[-p,d]);eq(fs,4,[-d])
+    return pool.top,cls,f,bits

+"""CAM-0008 B: finite exhaustive challenge to spare-colour recolouring."""
+import itertools

+def proper(es,col):return all(col[a]!=col[b] for a,b in es)
+
+
+def main():
+    save(ROOT/'spare_launch_hashes.json',{'tools/s007_spare.py':sha('tools/s007_spare.py')})
+    counts=[]
+    for n in range(2,6):
+        pairs=list(itertools.combinations(range(n),2));proper_count=0;challenges=0
+        for mask in range(1<<len(pairs)):
+            es=[e for j,e in enumerate(pairs) if mask>>j&1];adj=[set() for _ in range(n)]
+            for a,b in es:adj[a].add(b);adj[b].add(a)
+            nonedges=[e for j,e in enumerate(pairs) if not (mask>>j&1)]
+            for col in itertools.product(range(3),repeat=n):
+                if not proper(es,col):continue
+                proper_count+=1
+                for a,b in nonedges:
+                    new=list(col)
+                    if col[a]!=col[b]:
+                        for v in adj[a]:
+                            if col[v]==col[b]:new[v]=3
+                        assert proper(es,new)
+                        new[a]=col[b]
+                    assert proper(es,new) and new[a]==new[b]
+                    challenges+=1
+        counts.append(dict(n=n,all_labelled_graphs=1<<len(pairs),proper_three_colouring_assignments=proper_count,
+            nonadjacent_pair_challenges=challenges))
+    es=[(0,v) for v in range(1,5)]+[(1,2),(2,3),(3,4)]
+    all_col=[list(c) for c in itertools.product(range(3),repeat=5) if proper(es,c)]

+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from s007_run import ROOT,TMP,save
+from s007_cover import StrongCover
+from biplanar_cnf import read_edges
+
+
+def static_control(edgefile, splitfile):
+    """Complete an actual split, then pin its primary variables in the new CNF."""
+    import itertools
+    import networkx as nx
+    from pysat.solvers import Cadical153
+    from check_layers import certify_layer
+    edges=read_edges(edgefile); c=StrongCover(edges,lex=False)
+    split=json.loads(Path(splitfile).read_text())
+    layers=[];faces=[];rotations=[]
+    for key in ('E1','E2'):
+        g=nx.Graph();g.add_nodes_from(range(c.n));g.add_edges_from(split[key])
+        for a,b in itertools.combinations(range(c.n),2):
+            if g.has_edge(a,b):continue
+            g.add_edge(a,b)
+            if not nx.check_planarity(g)[0]:g.remove_edge(a,b)
+        assert g.number_of_edges()==3*c.n-6
+        good,emb=nx.check_planarity(g);assert good
+        seen=set();fs=set()
+        for a,b in emb.edges():
+            if (a,b) not in seen:
+                f=emb.traverse_face(a,b,seen);assert len(f)==3
+                fs.add(tuple(sorted(f)))
+        es={tuple(sorted(e)) for e in g.edges()}
+        layers.append(es);faces.append(fs);rotations.append(certify_layer(c.n,sorted(es)))
+    # Cover always includes layer-swap lex even with lex=False: order the two completions.
+    vector=lambda i:[int(e in layers[i]) for e in c.pairs]
+    if vector(0)>vector(1):
+        layers.reverse();faces.reverse();rotations.reverse()
+    assumptions=[]
+    for i in range(2):
+        assumptions.extend(c.E(i,*e) if e in layers[i] else -c.E(i,*e) for e in c.pairs)
+        assumptions.extend(c.F(i,*f) if f in faces[i] else -c.F(i,*f) for f in c.triples)
+    with Cadical153(bootstrap_with=c.base) as solver:
+        assert solver.solve(assumptions=assumptions), 'Actual completion rejected by stronger clauses'
+    return dict(n=c.n,completion_edges=[sorted(es) for es in layers],faces=[sorted(fs) for fs in faces],
+        independent_rotation_checks=rotations,static=c.static,primary_pin_check='SAT')
+
+
+def main():
+    assert (ROOT/'BASELINE_PASS.json').exists()
+    rows=[]
+    for row in json.loads((ROOT/'controls.json').read_text())['results']:
+        tag=f"control-{row['index']:02d}" if 'index' in row else 'control-'+row['tag']
+        ef=TMP/'replay'/f'{tag}.edges' if 'index' in row else Path(f"validation/S003/splits/{row['tag']}.edges")
+        split=TMP/'replay'/f'{tag}.split.json'
+        rows.append(dict(tag=tag,**static_control(str(ef),str(split))))
+        save(ROOT/'static_truth_controls.json',rows)
+    print('PASS23 actual-completion static truth controls')
+
+if __name__=='__main__':main()

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""CAM-0008 C: independent no-lex global D2 necessary face-incidence model."""
+import itertools
+import json
+import sys
+import shutil
+from pathlib import Path
+from pysat.card import CardEnc,EncType
+from pysat.formula import IDPool
+from pysat.solvers import Cadical153
+from biplanar_cnf import read_edges
+from s004_certify import write_cnf
+from s005_replay import sha
+from s005_search import run_logged,compress
+from s005_dense import faces
+from check_layers import certify_layer
+from s007_run import ROOT,TMP,CHECKER,save,INDICES
+
+
+def encode(edges):
+    n=1+max(max(e) for e in edges);eset=set(edges)
+    assert n>=4 and len(eset)==len(edges)==6*n-14
+    pairs=list(itertools.combinations(range(n),2));pool=IDPool()
+    bits={e:[pool.id(('extra',e))] if e in eset else [pool.id(('present',e)),pool.id(('double',e))] for e in pairs}
+    triples=[q for q in itertools.combinations(range(n),3)
+        if sum(e not in eset for e in itertools.combinations(q,2))<=2]
+    f={q:pool.id(('global-face',q)) for q in triples}
+    cls=CardEnc.equals([x for values in bits.values() for x in values],bound=2,vpool=pool,encoding=EncType.totalizer).clauses
+    incident={e:[] for e in pairs}
+    for q in triples:
+        for e in itertools.combinations(q,2):
+            incident[e].append(f[q])
+            if e not in eset:cls.append([-f[q],bits[e][0]])
+    def eq(lits,demand,gates):
+        if len(lits)<demand:
+            cls.append(gates)
+        else:
+            cls.extend(gates+c for c in CardEnc.equals(lits,bound=demand,vpool=pool,encoding=EncType.seqcounter).clauses)
+    for e in pairs:
+        fs=incident[e]
+        if e in eset:
+            z=bits[e][0];eq(fs,2,[z]);eq(fs,4,[-z])
+        else:
+            p,d=bits[e];cls.append([-d,p])
+            cls.extend([[p,-v] for v in fs])
+            eq(fs,2,[-p,d]);eq(fs,4,[-d])
+    return pool.top,cls,f,bits
+
+
+def controls():
+    w=json.loads(Path('validation/degree11_witness.json').read_text())
+    n=w['num_vertices'];layers=[{tuple(e) for e in w[k]} for k in ('edges_part1','edges_part2')]
+    assert not layers[0]&layers[1]
+    es=sorted(layers[0]|layers[1]);fs=[faces(n,sorted(x)) for x in layers]
+    assert not fs[0]&fs[1]
+    rows=[]
+    for removed in ((es[0],es[1]),(es[0],es[-1]),(es[-2],es[-1])):
+        edges=sorted(set(es)-set(removed));nv,cls,f,bits=encode(edges)
+        selected=fs[0]|fs[1];assert selected<=set(f)
+        assumptions=[v if q in selected else -v for q,v in f.items()]
+        for e,values in bits.items():
+            multiplicity=sum(e in layer for layer in layers)
+            assumptions.extend([values[0] if multiplicity==2 else -values[0]] if e in set(edges)
+                else [values[0] if multiplicity>=1 else -values[0],values[1] if multiplicity==2 else -values[1]])
+        with Cadical153(bootstrap_with=cls) as solver:assert solver.solve(assumptions=assumptions)
+        rows.append(dict(n=n,removed=removed,variables=nv,clauses=len(cls),completion_faces=[sorted(x) for x in fs],
+            completion_edges=[sorted(x) for x in layers],component_faces=[certify_layer(n,sorted(x)) for x in layers],
+            primary_pinned_actual_assignment='SAT'))
+    save(ROOT/'global_controls.json',rows)
+    print('PASS3 exact D2 actual completion/face/multiplicity controls',flush=True)
+
+
+def search():
+    root=ROOT/'global';root.mkdir(exist_ok=True);tmp=TMP/'global';tmp.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    solver=str(Path('artifacts/tmp/S004/cadical.exe').resolve())
+    save(ROOT/'global_launch_hashes.json',{p:sha(p) for p in ('tools/s007_global.py','tools/s005_search.py')})
+    assert (ROOT/'BASELINE_PASS.json').exists();controls()
+    rows=[];consecutive=0
+    for idx in INDICES:
+        ef=ROOT/'targets'/f'row{idx}.edges';prefix=tmp/f'row{idx}';cnf=Path(str(prefix)+'.cnf');proof=Path(str(prefix)+'.drat')
+        nv,cls,_,_=encode(read_edges(ef));write_cnf(cnf,nv,cls)
+        row=dict(index=idx,verdict='UNKNOWN',edgefile=str(ef),variables=nv,clauses=len(cls),cnf_sha256=sha(cnf))
+        if consecutive>=2:row['reason']='NOT_RUN after two consecutive final UNKNOWNs'
+        else:
+            run=run_logged([solver,'-q','--no-binary',str(cnf),str(proof)],320,str(prefix)+'.solve.log');row['solve']=run
+            if run['returncode']==10:row['verdict']='SAT_RELAXATION'
+            elif run['returncode']==20:
+                regen=Path(str(prefix)+'.regenerated.cnf');write_cnf(regen,*encode(read_edges(ef))[:2])
+                assert regen.read_bytes()==cnf.read_bytes()
+                log=Path(str(prefix)+'.check.log')
+                check=run_logged([CHECKER,str(cnf),str(proof),'-t','1200'],1220,log);row['check']=check
+                if check['returncode']==0 and 's VERIFIED' in log.read_text():
+                    core=Path(str(prefix)+'.core.drat');trimlog=Path(str(prefix)+'.trim.log')
+                    trim=run_logged([CHECKER,str(cnf),str(proof),'-l',str(core),'-t','600'],620,trimlog)
+                    row['trim']=trim;selected=proof
+                    if trim['returncode']==0 and core.exists() and 's VERIFIED' in trimlog.read_text():
+                        corelog=Path(str(prefix)+'.core.check.log')
+                        chk=run_logged([CHECKER,str(cnf),str(core),'-t','600'],620,corelog);row['core_check']=chk
+                        if chk['returncode']==0 and 's VERIFIED' in corelog.read_text():selected=core
+                    dest=root/f'row{idx}';compress(cnf,str(dest)+'.cnf.gz');compress(selected,str(dest)+'.drat.gz')
+                    row.update(verdict='NON_BIPLANAR_DRAT_VERIFIED',original_proof_sha256=sha(proof),original_proof_bytes=proof.stat().st_size,
+                        archive=str(dest)+'.drat.gz',archive_sha256=sha(str(dest)+'.drat.gz'),
+                        archive_raw_sha256=sha(selected),archive_raw_bytes=selected.stat().st_size)
+            consecutive=consecutive+1 if row['verdict']=='UNKNOWN' else 0
+            if proof.exists() and row['verdict']=='UNKNOWN':row['partial_proof_sha256']=sha(proof);row['partial_proof_bytes']=proof.stat().st_size
+            for suffix in ('.solve.log','.check.log','.trim.log','.core.check.log'):
+                p=Path(str(prefix)+suffix)
+                if p.exists():shutil.copyfile(p,root/(prefix.name+suffix))
+        rows.append(row);save(ROOT/'global_results.json',rows)
+        print('D2 global',idx,row['verdict'],flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__=='__main__':search()

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""CAM-0008 baseline, supervised searches and actual native proof checks."""
+import gzip
+import json
+import platform
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from s005_replay import sha
+from s005_search import run_logged
+from triangulation_cover import Cover
+from s007_cover import StrongCover
+from biplanar_cnf import read_edges
+from blowup_graph import blowup
+from blowup_chi_cnf import bag_cnf
+from s004_certify import write_cnf
+from check_layers import main as check_split
+from s006_run import certificate as old_certificate
+
+ROOT = Path('validation/S007')
+TMP = Path('artifacts/tmp/S007')
+CHECKER = str(Path('artifacts/tmp/S004/drat-trim-mingw.exe').resolve())
+INDICES = (162,155,157,159)
+
+
+def save(p, x):
+    Path(p).write_text(json.dumps(x, indent=1)+'\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
+
+
+def launch_hashes(mode):
+    files = ['tools/s007_run.py','tools/s007_cover.py','tools/triangulation_cover.py',
+             'tools/s005_search.py','tools/s005_replay.py','tools/biplanar_cegar.py']
+    save(ROOT/(mode+'_launch_hashes.json'), {p:sha(p) for p in files})
+
+
+def replay():
+    import networkx, pysat
+    old = json.loads(Path('validation/S006/environment.json').read_text())
+    hashes = {name:sha(Path('artifacts/tmp/S004')/name) for name in old['native_sha256']}
+    assert hashes == old['native_sha256']
+    pins = {}
+    for name, pin in old['native_sources'].items():
+        source = Path('artifacts/tmp/S004')/name
+        got = subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(source),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
+        status = subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(source),'status','--porcelain'],text=True)
+        assert got == pin and not status
+        pins[name] = got
+    save(ROOT/'environment.json',dict(python=sys.version,platform=platform.platform(),
+        networkx=networkx.__version__,python_sat=pysat.__version__,native_sha256=hashes,
+        native_sources=pins,build='S004 reused; no build'))
+    # Reuse inherited baseline without writing to any previous session.
+    text = Path('tools/s005_replay.py').read_text().replace("'validation/S005'", "'validation/S007'")
+    text = text.replace("'artifacts/tmp/S005/replay'", "'artifacts/tmp/S007/replay'")
+    text = 'import sys\nsys.path.insert(0, '+repr(str(Path('tools').resolve()))+')\n'+text
+    adapter = TMP/'baseline.py'; adapter.write_text(text, newline='\n')
+    save(ROOT/'baseline_launch_hash.json',dict(path=str(adapter),sha256=sha(adapter)))
+    run = run_logged([sys.executable,str(adapter)],2400,ROOT/'baseline.log')
+    save(ROOT/'baseline_command.json',run)
+    assert run['returncode'] == 0
+    cold=[]
+    for session, filenames in [('S005',['search_results.json']),('S006',['search_results.json','larger_search_results.json'])]:
+        rows=[]
+        for name in filenames:
+            rows.extend(json.loads(Path('validation',session,name).read_text()))
+        for r in rows:
+            if r['verdict'] != 'NON_BIPLANAR_DRAT_VERIFIED':
+                continue
+            idx = r['target']['index']; rec = r['certificate']
+            src = Path('validation',session,'search',f'cover-row{idx}')
+            dest = TMP/'cold'/f'{session}-row{idx}'; dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
+            cnf = Path(str(dest)+'.cnf'); proof = Path(str(dest)+'.drat')
+            cnf.write_bytes(gzip.decompress(Path(str(src)+'.cnf.gz').read_bytes()))
+            proof.write_bytes(gzip.decompress(Path(rec['archive']).read_bytes()))
+            assert sha(cnf)==rec['cnf_sha256'] and sha(proof)==rec['archive_raw_sha256']
+            d=json.loads(Path(str(src)+'.cuts.json').read_text())
+            c=Cover(read_edges(r['target']['edgefile']),d['lex'],d.get('short_links',False));c.cuts=d['cuts']
+            regen=Path(str(dest)+'.regenerated.cnf');c.write_cnf(regen)
+            assert regen.read_bytes()==cnf.read_bytes()
+            log=ROOT/f'cold-{session}-row{idx}.check.log'
+            check=run_logged([CHECKER,str(cnf),str(proof),'-t','1200'],1220,log)
+            assert check['returncode']==0 and 's VERIFIED' in log.read_text()
+            cold.append(dict(session=session,index=idx,command=check,checker='VERIFIED',
+                cnf_sha256=sha(cnf),proof_sha256=sha(proof),archive_sha256=sha(rec['archive'])))
+            save(ROOT/'cold_prior.json',cold)
+            print('cold',session,idx,'VERIFIED',flush=True)
+    assert len(cold)==40
+    targets=[]
+    source=json.loads(Path('validation/S003/survivors_alpha_ge3.json').read_text())
+    chi=json.loads(Path('validation/S004/chi10_results.json').read_text())
+    for idx in INDICES:
+        g,w,_=source[idx];rec=chi[idx];es,_=blowup(g,w)
+        ef=ROOT/'targets'/f'row{idx}.edges';ef.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+        ef.write_text(''.join(f'{a} {b}\n' for a,b in es),newline='\n')
+        col=rec['ten_colouring'];assert len(col)==sum(w) and all(0<=x<10 for x in col)
+        assert all(col[a]!=col[b] for a,b in es)
+        cnf=TMP/f'chi-row{idx}.cnf';proof=TMP/f'chi-row{idx}.drat'
+        write_cnf(cnf,*bag_cnf(g,w,9));proof.write_bytes(gzip.decompress(Path(rec['bag']['archive']).read_bytes()))
+        assert sha(cnf)==rec['bag']['cnf_sha256'] and sha(proof)==rec['bag']['drat_sha256']
+        log=ROOT/f'chi-row{idx}.check.log'
+        check=run_logged([CHECKER,str(cnf),str(proof),'-t','600'],620,log)
+        assert check['returncode']==0 and 's VERIFIED' in log.read_text()
+        targets.append(dict(index=idx,g6=g,w=w,n=sum(w),m=len(es),D=6*sum(w)-12-len(es),
+            edgefile=str(ef),edge_sha256=sha(ef),ten_colouring=col,chi=10,chromatic_check=check,
+            bag_cnf_sha256=sha(cnf),bag_proof_sha256=sha(proof),bag_archive=rec['bag']['archive']))
+        save(ROOT/'targets.json',targets)
+    controls=[]
+    for row in json.loads((ROOT/'controls.json').read_text())['results']:
+        tag=f"control-{row['index']:02d}" if 'index' in row else 'control-'+row['tag']
+        ef=TMP/'replay'/f'{tag}.edges' if 'index' in row else Path(f"validation/S003/splits/{row['tag']}.edges")
+        prefix=TMP/('strong-'+tag)
+        # Supervision protects even a baseline control from a blocked solver call.
+        log=ROOT/(tag+'.strong.log')
+        run=run_logged([sys.executable,'tools/s007_cover.py',str(ef),str(prefix),'30','--lex'],50,log)
+        assert run['returncode']==0
+        result=json.loads(Path(str(prefix)+'.result.json').read_text())
+        assert result['verdict']=='SAT_CHECKED'
+        check_split(str(ef),str(prefix)+'.split.json')
+        controls.append(dict(tag=tag,command=run,result=result,
+            split=json.loads(Path(str(prefix)+'.split.json').read_text())))
+        save(ROOT/'strong_controls.json',controls)

+# S007 critical exteriors and heavy-endblock excess
+
+These are necessary constraints on an actual finite simple12-critical biplanar graph, not an11-colouring theorem. Gallai low-block structure and the extension criterion retain the external dependency SRC-0027; K9 exclusion is SRC-0014. Novelty is not established. The source's Section2.3 already uses spare colours and independent exterior vertices; this application does not claim that method as new.
+
+## A spare colour exposes each low component
+
+Let L be the degree11 vertices, H its complement, and C any component of G[L]. Then
+
+    chi(G-C)=11.
+
+Proof. Criticality supplies the upper bound11. Suppose instead that F=G-C has a proper colouring with colours1..10. Colour11 is unused. Restrict to its vertices in H. SRC-0027 Theorem1.3 applies since every vertex outside H has degree11; components of L have no edges between them. If that restriction already satisfies criterion(a) or(b) for C, extend through C and retain the colouring of the other components from F, contradiction. Otherwise every exterior set is rainbow and noncut vertices in an endblock have the same exterior palette.
+
+If C has a light pair x,y, their actual exterior sets X,Y differ and have equal sizes. Choose a vertex a in X\Y and recolour just a with the unused colour11. This is proper in all of F. The new palettes differ, so criterion(b) extends C.
+
+If C is not light and has at least two vertices, choose an endblock B. All its noncut vertices have identical actual exterior set A. If B=K_s, s<=8, then |A|=12-s. If A were a clique, one noncut vertex together with A and the other noncut core vertices gives a clique of order12 when B=C, or11 when B has one cut vertex. Either contradicts K9 exclusion. Thus A has independent vertices a,b. Recolour both with colour11; they are nonadjacent and the colour was unused, so properness is preserved and criterion(a) holds. If B is an odd-cycle block (nontriangle), every noncut vertex has internal degree2 and |A|=9. A cannot be a clique by K9 exclusion, so the same recolouring applies. Triangles are included in the clique case. For C a singleton, its11 exterior neighbours cannot be a clique, and the same independent-pair recolouring applies. Extension again contradicts criticality.
+
+This proof handles empty H by the supposition and disconnected F without any common planar embedding. It changes F only on H, so its existing colours on L-C remain proper and extend unchanged. Therefore chi(F)=11. In particular, when L is nonempty and connected, chi(G[H])=11. With several low components, deleting one component is not deleting all of L: no claim that chi(H)=11 in general follows. Nor can these separate recolourings automatically be performed simultaneously; chosen vertices for different components may be adjacent.
+
+## Heavy clique endblock support bound
+
+Let an endblock B=K_s, s<=8, of a nonsingle-block low component have noncut core T of order r=s-1, cut vertex z and identical actual exterior set A of order12-s. Every vertex of T has exactly the same outside neighbourhood A union{z}. For every independent Z subset A with |Z|=q>=2,
+
+    sum_(a in Z)(deg_G(a)-12) >= (s-2)q-11.
+
+Proof. Criticality gives a proper11-colouring phi of G-T. If two vertices of Z could be recoloured with the same colour i without affecting the rest, the colours appearing on A would repeat. The entire outside boundary of T would then use at most(|A|-1)+1=12-s=11-r colours, leaving at least r colours to assign injectively to T. That is a proper11-colouring of G, contradiction.
+
+Consequently, for each of the11 colours, at most one vertex of Z has no neighbour of that colour in G-(T union Z). Z is independent, so these are exactly the constraints needed for the proposed simultaneous recolouring of two vertices. At least q-1 vertices of Z are blocked for each colour. Each edge from Z to G-(T union Z) contributes at most one such colour/vertex incidence, giving at least11(q-1) edges across that cut. Every a in Z also has r neighbours in T and none in Z. Summing its total degrees and subtracting12q gives
+
+    rq+11(q-1)-12q=(r-1)q-11=(s-2)q-11.
+
+All a belong to H by definition of exterior; the summands are nonnegative. No upper-degree premise or greedy extension of uncoloured exterior vertices is assumed. We start with an actual colouring of all G-T, keep all vertices outside the selected pair fixed, and use only the independence of Z. This is a counting constraint from criticality, not a positive graph construction.
+
+For a heavy K8 endblock, its seven noncut vertices form K7. An edge within A would complete K9 with that core, so A is independent of order4. The inequality yields
+
+    sum_(a in A)(deg_G(a)-12) >=13,
+
+and at least one of these four exterior vertices has degree>=16. The local subgraph on T, A and z contains K7 joined to five independent vertices after deleting any edges from z to A. Its actual biplanarity challenge is recorded separately, not inferred from Euler or its8-colouring. A single-block K8 component is light as in S006; this heavy conclusion applies only to a genuine endblock with a cut vertex.
+
+For a heavy single-block K_s component, the same counting proof with r=s and no cut yields sum_Z(deg-12)>=(s-1)q-11. A single-block K8 is already impossible as heavy by K9 exclusion. Different endblocks may reuse A and its edges, so summing these bounds over endblocks without controlling overlaps would double count. These conditions do not contradict unbounded Q, h or D.
+
+## Rejected paths and remaining theorem obligations
+
+Recolouring independent neighbours with an unused colour is legitimate only when the exterior colouring uses at most10 colours. An arbitrary11-colouring has no guaranteed spare colour. The triangle fan K1 joined to P4 has two nonadjacent path endpoints that are forced to have different colours in every proper3-colouring; this is a planar generic counterexample to dropping the spare-colour hypothesis. The programme does not extrapolate it to a12-critical witness.
+
+The all-order result chi(G-C)=11 establishes precisely where the spare colour is absent in a critical obstruction. It does not bound chi(H) for multiple components, furnish a simultaneous independent selection, certify contractions/identifications in both layers, or prove any reducible configuration. K9-free heavy boundaries are not automatically flexible in an11-chromatic exterior. The high-excess support bound permits concentrated excess and repeated boundaries. Large-deficit control, all-component extension, a universal proof and independent adversarial review remain open. The S005/S006 Gallai inequalities both remain valid with their different component corrections.

+## StrongCover necessity at any deficit
+
+For any genuine biplanar n>=4 input, independently complete its two planar layers to sphere triangulations on the same vertex set. For every vertex set S, a completed layer induced on S is simple planar and has at most3|S|-6 edges when |S|>=3. StrongCover uses every union of closed-twin bags and every one-vertex complement as selected necessary instances of this inequality. It also forbids monochromatic input K5s, because each layer is planar. Neither set of cuts claims a complete planarity characterization. Vertex sets of sizes0..2 are deliberately omitted from the Euler3s-6 formula. Auxiliary cardinality variables admit every primary solution obeying those inequalities.

+The existing common-order layer-swap/input automorphism lex constraints are sound by selecting the lexicographically least primary edge vector among all completed solutions in its symmetry orbit. No isolated first-edge unit from Cegar is inserted into Cover. Connectivity/link cut syntax and necessity remain as in the original Cover. A lack of a satisfying relaxed model requires an actually checked DRAT proof before any exclusion; a satisfying model still needs both actual layers/rotations and all colouring obligations.

+## Distinct global faces for D<=2
+
+For input edges E and completed layers T1,T2, let o(e) in{0,1,2} be occurrence multiplicity. Input pairs have o>=1. The exact surplus identity is
+
+    D=6n-12-|E|=sum_(e in E)(o(e)-1)+sum_(e notin E)o(e).
+
+If the same labelled triangle is facial in both layers, each of its three pairs has o=2. Each input pair costs one surplus, and each noninput pair costs two. Thus D>=3. Therefore when D<=2, the two sets of facial triples are disjoint. This proves the new extension beyond the inherited D<=1 shortcut; it NEVER permits a distinct-global-face premise at D>=3. D3 can have three doubled input pairs forming a common face; no contrary assertion is made.
+
+For D=2, combine the two actual facial sets into a single0/1 selection. Every pair has exactly2o(e) incident selected faces. Input pairs have one surplus bit, noninput pairs two monotone multiplicity bits; total surplus is2. A selected triangle has at most two noninput pairs, since three already cost>=3. This yields the separate no-lex global incidence CNF. The converse is absent: layer consistency, connectivity and vertex links are deliberately forgotten. Its SAT assignments cannot decide biplanarity. It shares the classical completion premise, PySAT library and native solver with other encodings; its independent numbering/no symmetry and direct projected-incidence counts are separate checks, not external formal verification.

+
+Internal review by the session agent, independent native DRAT checks, LR planarity, a separate stdlib sphere-rotation checker, direct SAT clause/projection checks and explicit counterexamples. These are independent checks of specific obligations with shared premises/libraries, not an independent external universal-theorem review. No universal upper theorem was proved; that review gate remains open.
+
+## Necessity and finite-scope attacks
+
+Euler cuts apply only at subset size>=3; complements and closed-twin bag unions are selected necessary cuts, not a complete graph-universe enumeration. K5 clauses are individually necessary and enumerated over every input five-set. All extra constraints remain true under actual completed solutions and their automorphism images, so an orbit minimum satisfies every lex inequality even if a selected subset family is not invariant. Existing Cover and Cegar use different primary orders and layer-swap conventions: their first-edge units are not mixed.
+
+The D<=2 face consequence was proved from the exact surplus identity. A repeated facial triple would need at least three surplus occurrences. No D>=3 restriction was smuggled into either encoding; completions can overlap and contain noninput pairs. The reduced global CNF counts input and noninput multiplicities differently, and the second noninput bit implies the first. All four SAT assignments are directly verified against regenerated clauses and explicit face counts; no planar converse claimed.
+
+The23 inherited/strong positive controls chiefly have larger deficit. This test-coverage gap was noticed and supplemented prospectively with three exact D2 deletion controls on the actual42-vertex triangulation pair. These test two new pairs; not all D2 overlap types were tested, and the hand proof, not control coverage, supplies general necessity. A hard cap or partial lemma set is never a negative. The source D2 stratum has42 rows, whereas full/global searches target four. C5/whole k8/k9 censuses and row165 independent no-lex challenge remain open.
+
+## Criticality and palette attacks
+
+The exterior-deletion theorem uses a10-colouring of the whole G-C, not merely of H. A fresh colour on one symmetric-difference vertex makes a light pair good. For a heavy endblock, actual common exterior sets were used; K9 exclusion gives a nonadjacent pair, so recolouring both to an UNUSED colour preserves every edge of G-C. The extension theorem applies to H and C; other low components keep their proper colours because recolouring was proper in the whole exterior and no edge joins different low components. Singleton/odd-cycle/clique endblocks and the cut/noncut distinction are covered. This proves chi(G-C)=11, and proves chi(H)=11 only when L is connected. Extending that conclusion to disconnected L would change the deleted set and is unsupported.
+
+In a heavy K8 endblock, seven noncut vertices and any adjacent pair in A would form K9, so the four actual exterior vertices are independent. In a colouring of G-T, if any of11 colours is unblocked for two of those independent vertices, recolouring that pair makes A nonrainbow. The cut vertex adds at most one boundary colour; seven colours remain for the core. Counting blocked vertex/colour incidences requires at least33 edges from A to G-(T union A); adding28 core edges forces sum(deg(A))>=61 and excess>=13. No assumption of bounded high degrees, extension of uncoloured A, simultaneous swaps or shared planar separation was inserted. General independent-Z/single-block variants have their different coefficients written explicitly.
+
+These are necessary constraints, not contradictions with unbounded exterior excess, order or deficit. Distinct endblocks may share high vertices, so support inequalities cannot be summed freely. The finite local K6-I6 graph has exactchi7 and planar layers, but does not satisfy12-criticality or high exterior degrees. The K7-I5 verdict is supplied by the actual run records. The planar triangle fan forces two nonadjacent vertices distinct with no spare colour, refuting the unconditional co-colouring guess. There is no independent transversal or all-component recolouring theorem.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""CAM-0008 necessary planar-subset/K5 cuts for arbitrary-deficit Cover."""
+import itertools
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from pysat.card import CardEnc, EncType
+from triangulation_cover import Cover
+from biplanar_cnf import read_edges
+
+VERSION = 'S007-subsets-K5-Dle2-v1'
+
+
+class StrongCover(Cover):
+    def __init__(self, edges, lex=False, short_links=False):
+        super().__init__(edges, lex, short_links)
+        adj = {v: {v} for v in range(self.n)}
+        for a, b in edges:
+            adj[a].add(b); adj[b].add(a)
+        groups = {}
+        for v in range(self.n):
+            groups.setdefault(tuple(sorted(adj[v])), []).append(v)
+        self.groups = list(groups.values())
+        # The campaign restricts expensive complete bag-union generation to <=11 bags.
+        assert len(self.groups) <= 11
+        subsets = {tuple(v for j, bag in enumerate(self.groups) if mask >> j & 1 for v in bag)
+                   for mask in range(1, 1 << len(self.groups))}
+        subsets |= {tuple(v for v in range(self.n) if v != omitted) for omitted in range(self.n)}
+        subsets = sorted({tuple(sorted(s)) for s in subsets if 3 <= len(s) < self.n})
+        initial = len(self.base)
+        for s in subsets:
+            bound = 3 * len(s) - 6
+            if len(s) * (len(s)-1)//2 <= bound:
+                continue
+            for layer in range(2):
+                self.base.extend(CardEnc.atmost([self.E(layer, a, b) for a, b in itertools.combinations(s, 2)],
+                    bound=bound, vpool=self.pool, encoding=EncType.seqcounter).clauses)
+        original = set(edges)
+        k5 = 0
+        for vs in itertools.combinations(range(self.n), 5):
+            es = list(itertools.combinations(vs, 2))
+            if all(e in original for e in es):
+                k5 += 1
+                for layer in range(2):
+                    self.base.append([-self.E(layer, *e) for e in es])
+        deficit = 6*self.n - 12 - len(edges)
+        if deficit <= 2:
+            self.base.extend([[-self.F(0, *q), -self.F(1, *q)] for q in self.triples])
+        self.static = dict(version=VERSION, groups=self.groups, subset_count=len(subsets),
+            input_K5_count=k5, distinct_faces_enabled=deficit <= 2,
+            extra_clauses=len(self.base)-initial)
+
+    def save(self, prefix, verdict, iterations, start):
+        meta = super().save(prefix, verdict, iterations, start)
+        meta['static'] = self.static
+        Path(prefix+'.result.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta, indent=1)+'\n', newline='\n')
+        Path(prefix+'.cuts.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(lex=self.lex,
+            short_links=self.short_links, cuts=self.cuts, static=self.static), indent=1)+'\n', newline='\n')
+        return meta
+
+
+def main():
+    if sys.argv[1] == 'check':
+        _, _, ef, prefix = sys.argv
+        d = json.loads(Path(prefix+'.cuts.json').read_text())
+        c = StrongCover(read_edges(ef), d['lex'], d.get('short_links', False))
+        assert c.static == d['static']
+        c.cuts = d['cuts']
+        c.write_cnf(Path(prefix+'.regenerated.cnf'))
+        assert Path(prefix+'.cnf').read_bytes() == Path(prefix+'.regenerated.cnf').read_bytes()
+        print('PASS stronger necessary CNF cold regeneration', len(c.cuts), 'lazy cuts')
+    else:
+        _, ef, prefix, seconds, *flags = sys.argv
+        print(json.dumps(StrongCover(read_edges(ef), '--lex' in flags).run(prefix, float(seconds))))
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+def encode(edges):
+    n=1+max(max(e) for e in edges);eset=set(edges)
+    assert n>=4 and len(eset)==len(edges)==6*n-14
+    pairs=list(itertools.combinations(range(n),2));pool=IDPool()
+    bits={e:[pool.id(('extra',e))] if e in eset else [pool.id(('present',e)),pool.id(('double',e))] for e in pairs}
+    triples=[q for q in itertools.combinations(range(n),3)
+        if sum(e not in eset for e in itertools.combinations(q,2))<=2]
+    f={q:pool.id(('global-face',q)) for q in triples}
+    cls=CardEnc.equals([x for values in bits.values() for x in values],bound=2,vpool=pool,encoding=EncType.totalizer).clauses
+    incident={e:[] for e in pairs}
+    for q in triples:
+        for e in itertools.combinations(q,2):
+            incident[e].append(f[q])
+            if e not in eset:cls.append([-f[q],bits[e][0]])
+    def eq(lits,demand,gates):
+        if len(lits)<demand:
+            cls.append(gates)
+        else:
+            cls.extend(gates+c for c in CardEnc.equals(lits,bound=demand,vpool=pool,encoding=EncType.seqcounter).clauses)
+    for e in pairs:
+        fs=incident[e]
+        if e in eset:
+            z=bits[e][0];eq(fs,2,[z]);eq(fs,4,[-z])
+        else:
+            p,d=bits[e];cls.append([-d,p])
+            cls.extend([[p,-v] for v in fs])
+            eq(fs,2,[-p,d]);eq(fs,4,[-d])
+    return pool.top,cls,f,bits

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""CAM-0008 B: finite exhaustive challenge to spare-colour recolouring."""
+import itertools
+from s007_run import ROOT,save
+from s005_replay import sha
+
+
+def proper(es,col):return all(col[a]!=col[b] for a,b in es)
+
+
+def main():
+    save(ROOT/'spare_launch_hashes.json',{'tools/s007_spare.py':sha('tools/s007_spare.py')})
+    counts=[]
+    for n in range(2,6):
+        pairs=list(itertools.combinations(range(n),2));proper_count=0;challenges=0
+        for mask in range(1<<len(pairs)):
+            es=[e for j,e in enumerate(pairs) if mask>>j&1];adj=[set() for _ in range(n)]
+            for a,b in es:adj[a].add(b);adj[b].add(a)
+            nonedges=[e for j,e in enumerate(pairs) if not (mask>>j&1)]
+            for col in itertools.product(range(3),repeat=n):
+                if not proper(es,col):continue
+                proper_count+=1
+                for a,b in nonedges:
+                    new=list(col)
+                    if col[a]!=col[b]:
+                        for v in adj[a]:
+                            if col[v]==col[b]:new[v]=3
+                        assert proper(es,new)
+                        new[a]=col[b]
+                    assert proper(es,new) and new[a]==new[b]
+                    challenges+=1
+        counts.append(dict(n=n,all_labelled_graphs=1<<len(pairs),proper_three_colouring_assignments=proper_count,
+            nonadjacent_pair_challenges=challenges))
+    es=[(0,v) for v in range(1,5)]+[(1,2),(2,3),(3,4)]
+    all_col=[list(c) for c in itertools.product(range(3),repeat=5) if proper(es,c)]
+    assert all_col and all(c[1]!=c[4] for c in all_col)
+    spare=[3,0,1,2,0];assert proper(es,spare) and spare[1]==spare[4]
+    save(ROOT/'spare_controls.json',dict(domain=counts,triangle_fan=dict(V=list(range(5)),edges=es,
+        every_proper_three_colouring=all_col,nonadjacent_pair=[1,4],forced_distinct_without_spare=True,
+        proper_four_colouring_with_equal_pair=spare),scope='Finite corroboration; hand proof is all-order; no12-critical witness'))
+    print('PASS finite spare-colour challenges and no-spare planar triangle-fan obstruction')
+
+
+if __name__=='__main__':main()

+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+from s007_run import ROOT,TMP,save
+from s007_cover import StrongCover
+from biplanar_cnf import read_edges
+
+
+def static_control(edgefile, splitfile):
+    """Complete an actual split, then pin its primary variables in the new CNF."""
+    import itertools
+    import networkx as nx
+    from pysat.solvers import Cadical153
+    from check_layers import certify_layer
+    edges=read_edges(edgefile); c=StrongCover(edges,lex=False)
+    split=json.loads(Path(splitfile).read_text())
+    layers=[];faces=[];rotations=[]
+    for key in ('E1','E2'):
+        g=nx.Graph();g.add_nodes_from(range(c.n));g.add_edges_from(split[key])
+        for a,b in itertools.combinations(range(c.n),2):
+            if g.has_edge(a,b):continue
+            g.add_edge(a,b)
+            if not nx.check_planarity(g)[0]:g.remove_edge(a,b)
+        assert g.number_of_edges()==3*c.n-6
+        good,emb=nx.check_planarity(g);assert good
+        seen=set();fs=set()
+        for a,b in emb.edges():
+            if (a,b) not in seen:
+                f=emb.traverse_face(a,b,seen);assert len(f)==3
+                fs.add(tuple(sorted(f)))
+        es={tuple(sorted(e)) for e in g.edges()}
+        layers.append(es);faces.append(fs);rotations.append(certify_layer(c.n,sorted(es)))
+    # Cover always includes layer-swap lex even with lex=False: order the two completions.
+    vector=lambda i:[int(e in layers[i]) for e in c.pairs]
+    if vector(0)>vector(1):
+        layers.reverse();faces.reverse();rotations.reverse()
+    assumptions=[]
+    for i in range(2):
+        assumptions.extend(c.E(i,*e) if e in layers[i] else -c.E(i,*e) for e in c.pairs)
+        assumptions.extend(c.F(i,*f) if f in faces[i] else -c.F(i,*f) for f in c.triples)
+    with Cadical153(bootstrap_with=c.base) as solver:
+        assert solver.solve(assumptions=assumptions), 'Actual completion rejected by stronger clauses'
+    return dict(n=c.n,completion_edges=[sorted(es) for es in layers],faces=[sorted(fs) for fs in faces],
+        independent_rotation_checks=rotations,static=c.static,primary_pin_check='SAT')
+
+
+def main():
+    assert (ROOT/'BASELINE_PASS.json').exists()
+    rows=[]
+    for row in json.loads((ROOT/'controls.json').read_text())['results']:
+        tag=f"control-{row['index']:02d}" if 'index' in row else 'control-'+row['tag']
+        ef=TMP/'replay'/f'{tag}.edges' if 'index' in row else Path(f"validation/S003/splits/{row['tag']}.edges")
+        split=TMP/'replay'/f'{tag}.split.json'
+        rows.append(dict(tag=tag,**static_control(str(ef),str(split))))
+        save(ROOT/'static_truth_controls.json',rows)
+    print('PASS23 actual-completion static truth controls')
+
+if __name__=='__main__':main()

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""CAM-0008 C: independent no-lex global D2 necessary face-incidence model."""
+import itertools
+import json
+import sys
+import shutil
+from pathlib import Path
+from pysat.card import CardEnc,EncType
+from pysat.formula import IDPool
+from pysat.solvers import Cadical153
+from biplanar_cnf import read_edges
+from s004_certify import write_cnf
+from s005_replay import sha
+from s005_search import run_logged,compress
+from s005_dense import faces
+from check_layers import certify_layer
+from s007_run import ROOT,TMP,CHECKER,save,INDICES
+
+
+def encode(edges):
+    n=1+max(max(e) for e in edges);eset=set(edges)
+    assert n>=4 and len(eset)==len(edges)==6*n-14
+    pairs=list(itertools.combinations(range(n),2));pool=IDPool()
+    bits={e:[pool.id(('extra',e))] if e in eset else [pool.id(('present',e)),pool.id(('double',e))] for e in pairs}
+    triples=[q for q in itertools.combinations(range(n),3)
+        if sum(e not in eset for e in itertools.combinations(q,2))<=2]
+    f={q:pool.id(('global-face',q)) for q in triples}
+    cls=CardEnc.equals([x for values in bits.values() for x in values],bound=2,vpool=pool,encoding=EncType.totalizer).clauses
+    incident={e:[] for e in pairs}
+    for q in triples:
+        for e in itertools.combinations(q,2):
+            incident[e].append(f[q])
+            if e not in eset:cls.append([-f[q],bits[e][0]])
+    def eq(lits,demand,gates):
+        if len(lits)<demand:
+            cls.append(gates)
+        else:
+            cls.extend(gates+c for c in CardEnc.equals(lits,bound=demand,vpool=pool,encoding=EncType.seqcounter).clauses)
+    for e in pairs:
+        fs=incident[e]
+        if e in eset:
+            z=bits[e][0];eq(fs,2,[z]);eq(fs,4,[-z])
+        else:
+            p,d=bits[e];cls.append([-d,p])
+            cls.extend([[p,-v] for v in fs])
+            eq(fs,2,[-p,d]);eq(fs,4,[-d])
+    return pool.top,cls,f,bits
+
+
+def controls():
+    w=json.loads(Path('validation/degree11_witness.json').read_text())
+    n=w['num_vertices'];layers=[{tuple(e) for e in w[k]} for k in ('edges_part1','edges_part2')]
+    assert not layers[0]&layers[1]
+    es=sorted(layers[0]|layers[1]);fs=[faces(n,sorted(x)) for x in layers]
+    assert not fs[0]&fs[1]
+    rows=[]
+    for removed in ((es[0],es[1]),(es[0],es[-1]),(es[-2],es[-1])):
+        edges=sorted(set(es)-set(removed));nv,cls,f,bits=encode(edges)
+        selected=fs[0]|fs[1];assert selected<=set(f)
+        assumptions=[v if q in selected else -v for q,v in f.items()]
+        for e,values in bits.items():
+            multiplicity=sum(e in layer for layer in layers)
+            assumptions.extend([values[0] if multiplicity==2 else -values[0]] if e in set(edges)
+                else [values[0] if multiplicity>=1 else -values[0],values[1] if multiplicity==2 else -values[1]])
+        with Cadical153(bootstrap_with=cls) as solver:assert solver.solve(assumptions=assumptions)
+        rows.append(dict(n=n,removed=removed,variables=nv,clauses=len(cls),completion_faces=[sorted(x) for x in fs],
+            completion_edges=[sorted(x) for x in layers],component_faces=[certify_layer(n,sorted(x)) for x in layers],
+            primary_pinned_actual_assignment='SAT'))
+    save(ROOT/'global_controls.json',rows)
+    print('PASS3 exact D2 actual completion/face/multiplicity controls',flush=True)
+
+
+def search():
+    root=ROOT/'global';root.mkdir(exist_ok=True);tmp=TMP/'global';tmp.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    solver=str(Path('artifacts/tmp/S004/cadical.exe').resolve())
+    save(ROOT/'global_launch_hashes.json',{p:sha(p) for p in ('tools/s007_global.py','tools/s005_search.py')})
+    assert (ROOT/'BASELINE_PASS.json').exists();controls()
+    rows=[];consecutive=0
+    for idx in INDICES:
+        ef=ROOT/'targets'/f'row{idx}.edges';prefix=tmp/f'row{idx}';cnf=Path(str(prefix)+'.cnf');proof=Path(str(prefix)+'.drat')
+        nv,cls,_,_=encode(read_edges(ef));write_cnf(cnf,nv,cls)
+        row=dict(index=idx,verdict='UNKNOWN',edgefile=str(ef),variables=nv,clauses=len(cls),cnf_sha256=sha(cnf))
+        if consecutive>=2:row['reason']='NOT_RUN after two consecutive final UNKNOWNs'
+        else:
+            run=run_logged([solver,'-q','--no-binary',str(cnf),str(proof)],320,str(prefix)+'.solve.log');row['solve']=run
+            if run['returncode']==10:row['verdict']='SAT_RELAXATION'
+            elif run['returncode']==20:
+                regen=Path(str(prefix)+'.regenerated.cnf');write_cnf(regen,*encode(read_edges(ef))[:2])
+                assert regen.read_bytes()==cnf.read_bytes()
+                log=Path(str(prefix)+'.check.log')
+                check=run_logged([CHECKER,str(cnf),str(proof),'-t','1200'],1220,log);row['check']=check
+                if check['returncode']==0 and 's VERIFIED' in log.read_text():
+                    core=Path(str(prefix)+'.core.drat');trimlog=Path(str(prefix)+'.trim.log')
+                    trim=run_logged([CHECKER,str(cnf),str(proof),'-l',str(core),'-t','600'],620,trimlog)
+                    row['trim']=trim;selected=proof
+                    if trim['returncode']==0 and core.exists() and 's VERIFIED' in trimlog.read_text():
+                        corelog=Path(str(prefix)+'.core.check.log')
+                        chk=run_logged([CHECKER,str(cnf),str(core),'-t','600'],620,corelog);row['core_check']=chk
+                        if chk['returncode']==0 and 's VERIFIED' in corelog.read_text():selected=core
+                    dest=root/f'row{idx}';compress(cnf,str(dest)+'.cnf.gz');compress(selected,str(dest)+'.drat.gz')
+                    row.update(verdict='NON_BIPLANAR_DRAT_VERIFIED',original_proof_sha256=sha(proof),original_proof_bytes=proof.stat().st_size,
+                        archive=str(dest)+'.drat.gz',archive_sha256=sha(str(dest)+'.drat.gz'),
+                        archive_raw_sha256=sha(selected),archive_raw_bytes=selected.stat().st_size)
+            consecutive=consecutive+1 if row['verdict']=='UNKNOWN' else 0
+            if proof.exists() and row['verdict']=='UNKNOWN':row['partial_proof_sha256']=sha(proof);row['partial_proof_bytes']=proof.stat().st_size
+            for suffix in ('.solve.log','.check.log','.trim.log','.core.check.log'):
+                p=Path(str(prefix)+suffix)
+                if p.exists():shutil.copyfile(p,root/(prefix.name+suffix))
+        rows.append(row);save(ROOT/'global_results.json',rows)
+        print('D2 global',idx,row['verdict'],flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__=='__main__':search()

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""CAM-0008 baseline, supervised searches and actual native proof checks."""
+import gzip
+import json
+import platform
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path

+from s005_search import run_logged

+from s007_cover import StrongCover
+from biplanar_cnf import read_edges
+from blowup_graph import blowup
+from blowup_chi_cnf import bag_cnf
+from s004_certify import write_cnf
+from check_layers import main as check_split
+from s006_run import certificate as old_certificate
+
+ROOT = Path('validation/S007')
+TMP = Path('artifacts/tmp/S007')
+CHECKER = str(Path('artifacts/tmp/S004/drat-trim-mingw.exe').resolve())
+INDICES = (162,155,157,159)
+
+
+def save(p, x):
+    Path(p).write_text(json.dumps(x, indent=1)+'\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
+
+
+def launch_hashes(mode):
+    files = ['tools/s007_run.py','tools/s007_cover.py','tools/triangulation_cover.py',
+             'tools/s005_search.py','tools/s005_replay.py','tools/biplanar_cegar.py']
+    save(ROOT/(mode+'_launch_hashes.json'), {p:sha(p) for p in files})
+
+
+def replay():
+    import networkx, pysat
+    old = json.loads(Path('validation/S006/environment.json').read_text())
+    hashes = {name:sha(Path('artifacts/tmp/S004')/name) for name in old['native_sha256']}
+    assert hashes == old['native_sha256']
+    pins = {}
+    for name, pin in old['native_sources'].items():
+        source = Path('artifacts/tmp/S004')/name
+        got = subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(source),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
+        status = subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(source),'status','--porcelain'],text=True)
+        assert got == pin and not status
+        pins[name] = got
+    save(ROOT/'environment.json',dict(python=sys.version,platform=platform.platform(),
+        networkx=networkx.__version__,python_sat=pysat.__version__,native_sha256=hashes,
+        native_sources=pins,build='S004 reused; no build'))
+    # Reuse inherited baseline without writing to any previous session.
+    text = Path('tools/s005_replay.py').read_text().replace("'validation/S005'", "'validation/S007'")
+    text = text.replace("'artifacts/tmp/S005/replay'", "'artifacts/tmp/S007/replay'")
+    text = 'import sys\nsys.path.insert(0, '+repr(str(Path('tools').resolve()))+')\n'+text
+    adapter = TMP/'baseline.py'; adapter.write_text(text, newline='\n')
+    save(ROOT/'baseline_launch_hash.json',dict(path=str(adapter),sha256=sha(adapter)))
+    run = run_logged([sys.executable,str(adapter)],2400,ROOT/'baseline.log')
+    save(ROOT/'baseline_command.json',run)
+    assert run['returncode'] == 0
+    cold=[]
+    for session, filenames in [('S005',['search_results.json']),('S006',['search_results.json','larger_search_results.json'])]:
+        rows=[]
+        for name in filenames:
+            rows.extend(json.loads(Path('validation',session,name).read_text()))
+        for r in rows:
+            if r['verdict'] != 'NON_BIPLANAR_DRAT_VERIFIED':
+                continue
+            idx = r['target']['index']; rec = r['certificate']
+            src = Path('validation',session,'search',f'cover-row{idx}')
+            dest = TMP/'cold'/f'{session}-row{idx}'; dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
+            cnf = Path(str(dest)+'.cnf'); proof = Path(str(dest)+'.drat')
+            cnf.write_bytes(gzip.decompress(Path(str(src)+'.cnf.gz').read_bytes()))
+            proof.write_bytes(gzip.decompress(Path(rec['archive']).read_bytes()))
+            assert sha(cnf)==rec['cnf_sha256'] and sha(proof)==rec['archive_raw_sha256']
+            d=json.loads(Path(str(src)+'.cuts.json').read_text())
+            c=Cover(read_edges(r['target']['edgefile']),d['lex'],d.get('short_links',False));c.cuts=d['cuts']
+            regen=Path(str(dest)+'.regenerated.cnf');c.write_cnf(regen)
+            assert regen.read_bytes()==cnf.read_bytes()
+            log=ROOT/f'cold-{session}-row{idx}.check.log'
+            check=run_logged([CHECKER,str(cnf),str(proof),'-t','1200'],1220,log)
+            assert check['returncode']==0 and 's VERIFIED' in log.read_text()
+            cold.append(dict(session=session,index=idx,command=check,checker='VERIFIED',
+                cnf_sha256=sha(cnf),proof_sha256=sha(proof),archive_sha256=sha(rec['archive'])))
+            save(ROOT/'cold_prior.json',cold)
+            print('cold',session,idx,'VERIFIED',flush=True)
+    assert len(cold)==40
+    targets=[]
+    source=json.loads(Path('validation/S003/survivors_alpha_ge3.json').read_text())
+    chi=json.loads(Path('validation/S004/chi10_results.json').read_text())
+    for idx in INDICES:
+        g,w,_=source[idx];rec=chi[idx];es,_=blowup(g,w)
+        ef=ROOT/'targets'/f'row{idx}.edges';ef.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+        ef.write_text(''.join(f'{a} {b}\n' for a,b in es),newline='\n')
+        col=rec['ten_colouring'];assert len(col)==sum(w) and all(0<=x<10 for x in col)
+        assert all(col[a]!=col[b] for a,b in es)
+        cnf=TMP/f'chi-row{idx}.cnf';proof=TMP/f'chi-row{idx}.drat'
+        write_cnf(cnf,*bag_cnf(g,w,9));proof.write_bytes(gzip.decompress(Path(rec['bag']['archive']).read_bytes()))
+        assert sha(cnf)==rec['bag']['cnf_sha256'] and sha(proof)==rec['bag']['drat_sha256']
+        log=ROOT/f'chi-row{idx}.check.log'
+        check=run_logged([CHECKER,str(cnf),str(proof),'-t','600'],620,log)
+        assert check['returncode']==0 and 's VERIFIED' in log.read_text()
+        targets.append(dict(index=idx,g6=g,w=w,n=sum(w),m=len(es),D=6*sum(w)-12-len(es),
+            edgefile=str(ef),edge_sha256=sha(ef),ten_colouring=col,chi=10,chromatic_check=check,
+            bag_cnf_sha256=sha(cnf),bag_proof_sha256=sha(proof),bag_archive=rec['bag']['archive']))
+        save(ROOT/'targets.json',targets)
+    controls=[]
+    for row in json.loads((ROOT/'controls.json').read_text())['results']:
+        tag=f"control-{row['index']:02d}" if 'index' in row else 'control-'+row['tag']
+        ef=TMP/'replay'/f'{tag}.edges' if 'index' in row else Path(f"validation/S003/splits/{row['tag']}.edges")
+        prefix=TMP/('strong-'+tag)
+        # Supervision protects even a baseline control from a blocked solver call.
+        log=ROOT/(tag+'.strong.log')
+        run=run_logged([sys.executable,'tools/s007_cover.py',str(ef),str(prefix),'30','--lex'],50,log)
+        assert run['returncode']==0
+        result=json.loads(Path(str(prefix)+'.result.json').read_text())
+        assert result['verdict']=='SAT_CHECKED'
+        check_split(str(ef),str(prefix)+'.split.json')
+        controls.append(dict(tag=tag,command=run,result=result,
+            split=json.loads(Path(str(prefix)+'.split.json').read_text())))
+        save(ROOT/'strong_controls.json',controls)
+    save(ROOT/'BASELINE_PASS.json',dict(cold_full_proofs=40,strong_controls=len(controls),fresh_chi10_targets=4,
+        inherited_baseline='K9/row165/bag;271 hash/CNF/colour audit;23 actual controls'))
+    print('BASELINE PASS',flush=True)
+
+
+def certificate(edgefile,prefix):
+    import s006_run
+    # Use the proven pipeline without overwriting earlier evidence; change generator only.
+    s006_run.ROOT=ROOT
+    text=Path('tools/s006_run.py').read_text()
+    start=text.index('def certificate(');end=text.index('\n\ndef search()',start)
+    code=text[start:end].replace('tools/triangulation_cover.py','tools/s007_cover.py')
+    scope=dict(s006_run.__dict__);exec(code,scope)
+    return scope['certificate'](edgefile,prefix)
+
+
+def search():
+    assert (ROOT/'BASELINE_PASS.json').exists()
+    (ROOT/'search').mkdir(exist_ok=True);(TMP/'search').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    rows=[];consecutive=0
+    for target in json.loads((ROOT/'targets.json').read_text()):
+        idx=target['index'];prefix=TMP/'search'/f'cover-row{idx}'
+        row=dict(target=target,verdict='UNKNOWN')
+        if consecutive>=2:
+            row['reason']='NOT_RUN after two consecutive final UNKNOWNs'
+        else:
+            run=run_logged([sys.executable,'tools/s007_cover.py',target['edgefile'],str(prefix),'900','--lex'],
+                920,str(prefix)+'.run.log');row['run']=run
+            meta=Path(str(prefix)+'.result.json')
+            if meta.exists():
+                row['search']=json.loads(meta.read_text())
+            if run['returncode']==0 and row.get('search',{}).get('verdict')=='UNSAT':
+                row['certificate']=certificate(target['edgefile'],prefix)
+                row['verdict']=row['certificate']['verdict']
+            elif run['returncode']==0 and row.get('search',{}).get('verdict')=='SAT_CHECKED':
+                check_split(target['edgefile'],str(prefix)+'.split.json')
+                shutil.copyfile(str(prefix)+'.split.json',ROOT/'search'/f'row{idx}.split.json')
+                row['verdict']='BIPLANAR_CHECKED_CHI10'
+            consecutive=consecutive+1 if row['verdict']=='UNKNOWN' else 0
+            for suffix in ('.cuts.json','.result.json','.run.log'):
+                p=Path(str(prefix)+suffix)
+                if p.exists():shutil.copyfile(p,ROOT/'search'/(prefix.name+suffix))
+        rows.append(row);save(ROOT/'search_results.json',rows)
+        print(idx,row['verdict'],row.get('run',{}).get('seconds','NOT_RUN'),flush=True)
+        if row['verdict']=='BIPLANAR_CHECKED_CHI10':break
+
+
+if __name__=='__main__':
+    ROOT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);TMP.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
+    launch_hashes(sys.argv[1]);{'replay':replay,'search':search}[sys.argv[1]]()
